summary: RenX Enterprises Corp. filed an 8-K on November 2, 2026 disclosure of an exchange agreement with an accredited investor that retired $1,022,971.22 of principal and accrued interest under a February 12, 2026 senior convertible note. In consideration, RenX issued a new senior convertible note of $1,037,283.93 (110% of prior principal) plus a warrant for 644,944 shares at a $2.895 initial conversion price (180% of new face value divided by that price). The company must convene a special meeting within 120 days (180-day fallback clock) for Nasdaq stockholder approval of conversion shares; an exchange cap limits issuance absent approval. Watch dilution and stockholder-approval risk, or the repeat-meeting escalation.
